summary: The most genre-faithful reply in the batch — second person held, nothing ever announced, and the shelf that re-crooks itself when you straighten it is the single best quiet-wrongness beat here — but it is one paragraph recited eleven times with the same five clauses, the comedy bait gets no counter-beat at all, and the box of cleared books simply stops existing.
